title: The order filed after the road
body: The map shows a road crossed out in red. The clipboard’s order is stamped received but has no issuing signature; a grocery list is clipped behind it, ending with ‘milk if open.’
rival_reading: A program office could file an access order without its final signature during routine work; an unsigned restriction does not prove a containment failure.
gloss: A road restriction is visible beside an officially received order that no one issued.

title: The source was filed as ‘later’
body: The notebook has a water amount beside two field names. The bottle’s label says HOLD FOR REVIEW; the source line says LATER in a different hand. A reminder on the cap reads ‘call Dad.’
rival_reading: Public staff could delay a supply source while managing road restrictions; a later note and a held bottle do not establish that an agricultural program malfunctioned.
gloss: A field-water amount is recorded while its source and release are deferred.
